elections.quote: When will the Democratic Party become a party of the working class?
Why Billionaires are Desperate to Defeat Graham Platner

The flood of billionaire money that will come against Graham Platner is no accident. Whether it is AI, AIPAC or crypto, billionaire-funded super PACs will spend hundreds of millions to defeat candidates who stand with working people and challenge their power.
Across the country, candidates willing to stand up for working people are taking on the establishment and WINNING.

Will Lawrence is running a people-powered campaign taking on Big Money interests. He's an organizer ready to champion Medicare for All, protect Social Security and demand accountability for AI companies. He's the exact type of leader the American people deserve in Congress.

Trey Martin is an ironworker, union president and eighth-generation Oklahoman who knows Oklahoma and the people who make it work. I’m confident Trey will be the kind of representative Oklahoma working families can count on.
